what: CLAVIOLINE turns the FM-1 into the 1950s Selmer Clavioline, the valve keyboard behind the lead line of "Telstar". Rebuilt from the original circuit diagrams: the 13 tone tablets, the percussive P attack, three-speed vibrato, the Concert model's sub-octaves, the knee lever on the PRESETS knob, and 40 period voicings from Violin to Musical Saw.
author: MammothCheese
